description: Hand-labeled evaluation subset for InsightFlow's analysis pipeline, drawn from the unique review texts of BuildBattle_2026_Customer_Feedback_Dataset.csv. Labeling protocol: (1) each text was read in full; (2) sentiment reflects net emotional tone - a problem plus an explicitly satisfactory resolution is 'positive', an unresolved problem is 'negative', factual all-clears and evenly mixed reviews are 'neutral'; (3) topic reflects the subject matter using InsightFlow's topic taxonomy; (4) texts where two defensible labels exist are marked ambiguous=true and scored separately. Labels were assigned by a human reviewer before running the pipeline, not exported from it.
